items.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.description: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function.
